comment: Which authored task covers which census eval_task. Explicit, not fuzzy-matched: a task counts as covering a census item only when someone decided it does, so the task-coverage number cannot drift on a keyword collision. Add an entry when you author a task; leave items out until a task genuinely exercises them.

suites.sales-world: tasks/sales-world — hand-authored, state-verified against the single world
suites.crmarena: tasks/crmarena — CRMArena's own metric (single answer, exact/fuzzy), served today by a separate parity world

notes.webhook-failure-triage: Integration-ops reliability work. Real CRM admin work, but the census has no item for it — recorded as covering nothing rather than stretched onto a neighbouring item.
notes.unlinked-invoice-reconciliation: Maps to quote_contract_consistency only loosely; it reconciles invoices to orders rather than quotes to contracts. Kept because the failure mode tested (documents that do not tie out) is the same one the census item names.
